name: Itch guard Plus Cream with Cooling Menthol 12g (Indian)
description:
Itch guard Plus Cream with Cooling Menthol 12g (Indian) 
Kills Fungus, Stops futher spread 
Dosage: wash & dry afftected area and apply the new Itch Guard + cream 2-3 times a day 
Storage Instructions: Protect from light, keep in cool dry place 
Manufactured/Marketed by: Reckitt Benckiser India Ltd. 
Keep out of reach of children
